"use client";

import { AppSwitcher } from "@/components/ui/app-switcher";
import { useDict } from "@/i18n/client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * The FinaOps mark: the group's ochre dot (the Workforce Ops mark) resting
 * on a thin ledger line — the balance. Same family, told apart at a glance
 * in the next browser tab.
 */
export function BrandMark({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden width="16" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 12" className={cn("shrink-0", className)}>
      <circle cx="8" cy="5" r="3.25" className="fill-accent" />
      <path d="M1 10.5h14" className="stroke-sidebar-fg" strokeWidth="1.25" strokeLinecap="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/**
 * The mark and the app's name, as the app switcher's trigger (ops-ui 1.1):
 * pressing it lists the suite's apps. Sidebar and phone top bar alike.
 */
export function BrandSwitcher() {
  const t = useDict();
  return (
    <AppSwitcher
      current="finaops"
      mark={
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <BrandMark />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-sidebar-fg-active">{t.shell.appName}</span>
        </span>
      }
    />
  );
}
